# Breeding API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A breeding pair, the dam and the sire, with the litters it produced.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/breeding/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/breeding/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `breeding` (detail, create, update), `breedings` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `project` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Uniqueness:** `name`, `project` unique together
- **Deleting:** clears the link on [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `performed`, `cancelled` **[required]**. Planned: prepared but nothing has happened yet. Performed: this record describes what was done. Cancelled: planned and then dropped; kept for the record. |
| `project` | [`project`](/api/stem/project/) id **[required]** |
| `mother` | [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) id **[required]** |
| `father` | [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) id **[required]** |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `tags` | list of strings; filter with `filter{tags.name}=<name>` |
| `birth_date` | date; nullable. Date of birth of the offspring. |
| `litter_size` | number; nullable. Expected or actual number of offspring. |
| `expected_genotype` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Expected genotype of the offspring. |
| `weaning_date` | date; nullable. Date the litter was or will be weaned (21-28 days after birth, typically; format: YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `start_date` | date; nullable. Date when this breeding started (pairing date; format: YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `end_date` | date; nullable. Date when this breeding ended (separation date; format: YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank if ongoing. |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/breeding/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('breeding', load_all=True)
records = resp['breedings']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('breeding', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.breedings;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/breeding/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('breeding', data={"name": "Breeding 1", "status": "performed", "project": "<project-id>", "mother": "<subject-id>", "father": "<subject-id>"})
record = resp.json()['breeding']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Breeding 1', 'status', 'performed', 'project', '<project-id>', 'mother', '<subject-id>', 'father', '<subject-id>'), 'breeding');
record = created.breeding;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/breeding/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('breeding', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['breeding']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('breeding', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.breeding;
```

### Response example

```json
        "father": "<subject-id>",

        "expected_genotype": "",

        "start_date": "2024-03-22",
        "end_date": "2024-03-22"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/breeding/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('breeding', id='<id>', data={"name": "Breeding 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Breeding 1 (renamed)'), 'breeding', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/breeding/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('breeding', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'breeding');
```

## Usage notes

- Both `mother` and `father` must belong to the breeding's `project`; otherwise the request is refused with `400`.
